text: Bitcoin's modest 1.3% gain is outpacing Ethereum's 0.6% rise, pushing BTC dominance to 59.7% and signaling investors are rotating toward perceived safety in the largest asset. The Fear & Greed Index at 29 reflects genuine risk-aversion that has worsened over the past week, yet total volume remains solid at $83B, suggesting this isn't capitulation but rather a cautious consolidation phase. Altcoins like SOL and BNB are holding minor gains alongside BTC, indicating the market hasn't fractured into forced selling despite the fearful sentiment.
